evals.name: critical-review-small-pipeline
evals.prompt: Lis tout le code de ~/work/sample-pipeline et donne-moi un avis critique sur l'architecture : points de rupture, ce qui est dur à maintenir, gérer et monitorer, étapes inutiles dans la CI/CD, et comment réduire la fragmentation.
evals.expected_output: A report with verdict, verified strengths, ranked breaking points with path:line evidence, separate maintain/manage/monitor lists, workflow waste, a tiered plan with effort and tradeoffs, and open questions. No file modified.
expectations: The report follows the verdict, what works, breaking points, hard-to-maintain/manage/monitor, workflow waste, plan, open questions structure
Findings cite concrete evidence such as file paths and line numbers
CI findings include missing timeouts, broad token permissions or unpinned third-party actions when they are present in the repo
Breaking points are ranked by severity and likelihood
Every recommendation states its cost or tradeoff
Things that could not be verified from the repo are said to be unverified
Recommendations favour removing moving parts over adding tooling
No file in the repository is modified

evals.name: review-with-failing-ci
evals.prompt: Donne-moi ton avis critique sur ce projet. La CI plante souvent et je ne sais pas si c'est le code ou le setup.
evals.expected_output: An architecture opinion that hands the analysis of failing runs to the ci-failure-analysis approach instead of guessing causes, and separates code issues from pipeline issues.
expectations: Failing runs are examined with run history or logs rather than speculated about
The assistant distinguishes problems in the code from problems in the pipeline setup
The report still covers architecture and not only the CI failures
